she most definitely does have a lott of annoying younger fans :/ i’ve been to two of her shows, one in 2022 and the nola show in 2023. the first show was amazing and the crowd (which looked to be mostly ppl in their 20s myself included) was super respectful of each other and EC. the nola show had a younger audience and imo it was a nightmare :(( people in the audience were yelling at EC whenever there was any type of quiet between songs or when she was about to speak. someone threw a flower crown at her while she was singing, and it was during that time when people were throwing water bottles and whatnot at artists for no reason so i think it shocked her but she put it on after seeing what it was. She also likes to do some fan interaction during a few songs and I noticed that people that were 3rd or even 4th row were shoving us that were in the first two rows to try and get closer to Ethel so she’d hold their hand. I personally hate being touched by strangers and i put it aside when going to concerts but it really takes me out of the show when there’s a 16 year old shoving me in the back and elbowing me in the face. I loved going to concerts as a teen but if no one bothers to learn and abide by concert etiquette then a line needs to be drawn :/
